title: feat(menu): Searchable menu widget
body:
**Summary**

Adds searchable props to the `menu` widget similar to `refinement-list`. This change adds additional properties to `connectMenu` and `menu`, as well as adding the relevant search templates. This will be used by the new merchandising console with the upgrade to `react-instantsearch-hooks`. They currently use the searchable `menu` component in `react-instantsearch-dom`. 

**Result**

Stories:
/story/refinements-menu--with-search
/story/refinements-menu--with-search-and-show-more

Screenshot: 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/69921547/194095030-5e8c6a65-b492-4d32-9a75-8e8b2acd2526.png)


fixes #2893
